user.title: Pair with the Better Kumo relay
user.description: Paste the pairing link from the relay's **Pair a phone…** page, or enter the relay URL and secret.

data_description.url: A Tailscale address keeps working when the computer is away from home.

error.invalid_link: This is not a Better Kumo pairing link.

error.invalid_secret: The secret contains characters that are not allowed.

abort.already_configured: This Kumospace account is already set up; its address and secret were updated.

data.phone_in_use_for: Phone counts as in use for

data_description.poll_interval: How often to read the state from the relay, in seconds (1–3600). Polling runs even when webhooks work.
data_description.away_after: Seconds without keyboard, mouse or trackpad input on the relay's computer after which At computer turns off (30–3600).
data_description.phone_in_use_for: Seconds after the Better Kumo phone app was last on screen during which Using phone stays on (30–3600); a call handed off to the phone keeps it on. The app reports every 30 s while open. Using phone is off when no phone has reported since the relay started, and unknown with a relay too old to report it.
data_description.webhook_url: Optional. Tried first by the relay, before the internal and external URLs of Home Assistant.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL that starts with http or https.
error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to 3600.
error.invalid_away_after: Enter a whole number of seconds from 30 to 3600.
error.invalid_phone_in_use_for: Enter a whole number of seconds from 30 to 3600.
